system.description: The Ebon Dragon cannot channel Virtues, but gains a second pool of Willpower points equal to his Essence rating that he can choose to refill when regaining points as normal. Points from this pool may be spent to power Ebon Dragon Charms (but not activate Combos), to resist unnatural mental influence, or to ignore all negative effects of a failed Virtue roll required by an external effect (one Willpower point per roll). If an Infernal learns this Charm, his Virtues drop to 1 and cannot be raised again; lost Virtue dots convert into experience. Until a character has Essence 10, his primary Virtue remains 3 for the sole purpose of Limit gain.
